│ ↑/k         up           enter pick     ? all keys                           │

│ pgup/ctrl+u page up      esc   setup                                         │
│ pgdn/ctrl+d page down                                                        │
│ home/g      first row                                                        │
│ end/G       last row                                                         │
│                                                                              │
